Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import numpy as np, os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def comps8(I,bg):
    H,W=I.shape; seen=np.zeros_like(I,bool); out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if I[i,j]==bg or seen[i,j]: continue
            st=[(i,j)]; c=[]
            while st:
                a,b=st.pop()
                if seen[a,b]: continue
                seen[a,b]=True; c.append((a,b))
                for dx in(-1,0,1):
                    for dy in(-1,0,1):
                        x,y=a+dx,b+dy
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and not seen[x,y] and I[x,y]!=bg: st.append((x,y))
            out.append(c)
    return out
def f(I, tie='larger'):
    I=np.array(I); H,W=I.shape; bg=int(I[0,0])
    comps=comps8(I,bg)
    clusters=[set(c) for c in comps if len(c)>1]
    seeds=[(c[0],int(I[c[0]])) for c in comps if len(c)==1]
    out=I.copy(); changed=True
    while changed:
        changed=False
        for (sr,sc),col in seeds:
            cand=[]
            for ti,tset in enumerate(clusters):
                dist=min(abs(sr-p[0])+abs(sc-p[1]) for p in tset)
                if dist<=1:
                    # orientation from relative pos of s wrt nearest touch cell
                    pts=[p for p in tset if abs(sr-p[0])<=1 and abs(sc-p[1])<=1]
                    if not pts: continue
                    tr,tc_=min(pts,key=lambda p:(abs(sr-p[0])+abs(sc-p[1])))
                    dr_,dc_=sr-tr_,sc-tc_
                    ok=False
                    if dc_!=0 and dr_==0:  # horizontal mirror axis
                        axis=(tc_+sc)/2
                        cells=[(r,round(2*axis-c)) for r,c in tset]
                        ok=True
                    elif dr_!=0 and dc_==0:  # vertical mirror
                        axis=(tr+sr)/2
                        cells=[(round(2*axis-r),c) for r,c in tset]
                        ok=True
                    if ok:
                        # count new cells that would be painted bg
                        nbg=sum(1 for r,c in cells if 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and out[r,c]==bg)
                        cand.append((-nbg, len(tset), ti, cells))
            if not cand: continue
            cand.sort()
            _,_,ti,cells=cand[0]
            for r,c in cells:
                if 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and out[r,c]==bg: out[r,c]=col
            changed=True
    return out.tolist()
for n in range(1,6):
    P=f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    print(n, P==O)

def solve(I):
    I=np.array(I); H,W=I.shape; bg=int(I[0,0])
    comps=comps8(I,bg)
    objs=[set(c) for c in comps if len(c)>1]; singles=[c[0] for c in comps if len(c)==1]
    out=I.copy()
    for s in singles:
        sr=sc_=None  # placeholder
        sr,scc=s
        col=int(I[sr,scc])
        # candidate touches: multi-cell obj with cell in 8-neighborhood
        best=None
        for o in objs:
            t=[(r,c) for r,c in o if abs(r-sr)<=1 and abs(c-sc_)<=1]
            if not t: continue
            tr,tc=t[0]
            dr,dc=sr-tr,sc_-tc
            cells=[]
            if dc!=0 and dr==0:  # horizontal reflection about vertical axis between tc and sc_
                axis=(tc+sc_)/2
                cells=[(round(2*axis-r),c) for r,c in o]
            elif dr!=0 and dc==0:
                axis=(tr+sr)/2
                cells=[(round(2*axis-r),c) for r,c in o]
            else: continue
            nbg=sum(1 for r,c in cells if 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and out[r,c]==bg)
            if best is None or nbg>best[0]: best=(nbg,o,cells)
        if best:
            for r,c in best[2]:
                if 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and out[r,c]==bg: out[r,c]=col
    return out.tolist()

def dihed(mask):
    res=[]; cur=np.array(mask,dtype=bool)
    for _ in range(4):

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
def comps4(I,bg):
    H,W=I.shape; seen=np.zeros_like(I,bool); out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if I[r,c]!=bg and not seen[r,c]:
                st=[(r,c)]; seen[r,c]=True; comp=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); comp.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and I[x,y]!=bg and not seen[x,y]:
                            seen[x,y]=True; st.append((x,y))
                out.append(comp)
    return out
def dihed(mask):
    res=[]; cur=np.array(mask,dtype=bool)
    for _ in range(4):
        for f in (cur, cur[:, ::-1]):
            key=tuple(map(tuple,f.astype(int).tolist()))
            if key not in [tuple(map(tuple,k.astype(int).tolist())) for k in res]:
                res.append(f)
        cur=np.rot90(cur)
    return res
# Hypothesis H: seed = singleton 4-comp adjacent to a host (big 4-comp).

for p in [1,2,3,4,5]:

    bg=int(Counter(I.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0])
    cs=comps4(I,bg)
    hosts={id(c):set(c) for c in cs if len(c)>1}

    print('--- demo',p,'hosts',len(hosts),'seeds',len(seeds))
    for col,(sr,sc) in seeds:

        adj=[h for h,s in hosts.items() if any(abs(a-sr)<=1 and abs(b-sc)<=1 for a,b in s)]
        if not adj: print('  seed',col,(sr,sc),'NO ADJACENT HOST'); continue
        h=adj[0]; rs=[a for a,_ in h]; cc=[b for _,b in h]
        rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax=min(rs),max(rs),min(cc),max(cc)
        dy = sr - (rmin+rmax)/2; dx = sc - (cmin+cmax)/2
        tname={'up':'v','dn':'v','lt':'h','rt':'h'}.get(None,None)
        tv = np.zeros((rmax-rmin+1,cmax-cmin+1),bool)
        for a,b in h: tv[a-rmin,b-cmin]=True
        if abs(dy)>=abs(dx): tv=tv[::-1,:]      # vertical flip if mainly above/below

        # placement: shift so copy is adjacent on seed side
        dr = int(np.sign(dy)*(rmax-rmin+1))+1 if dy>0 else -(rmax-rmin+1)-1

        pred=O.copy()

        rr0 = rmin+ ( (rmax-rmin+1)+1 if dy>0 else -(rmax-rmin+1)) if False else rmin
        # simpler: place copy bbox so its near edge is just beyond host edge
        if dy>0: base_r = rmax+1; base_c = cmin-(cmax-cmin+1) if False else cmin-(cmax-cmin+1)
        elif dy<0: base_r = rmin-1; base_c = None
        # let's do generic: place copy so that its bbox shares edge with host bbox facing seed
        br = rmax+1 if dy>0 else (rmin-1 if dy<0 else rmin)
        bc = cmax+1 if dx>0 else (cmin-1 if dx<0 else cmin)
        ok=True
        for a in range(tv.shape[0]):
            for b in range(tv.shape[1]):
                if tv[a,b]:
                    rr,cc2 = br+a, bc+b
                    if not(0<=rr<I.shape[0] and 0<=cc2<I.shape[1]): ok=False
                    elif I[rr,cc2]!=bg and I[rr,cc2]!=col: ok=False

import numpy as np
def components(g):
    H,W=len(g); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if seen[r][c]: continue
            col=g[r][c]; q=[(r,c)]; seen[r][c]=True; cl=[]
            while q:
                a,b=q.pop(); cl.append((a,b))
                for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    na,nb=a+dr,b+dc
                    if 0<=na<H and 0<=nb<W and not seen[na][nb] and g[na][nb]==col:
                        seen[na][nb]=True; q.append((na,nb))
            out.append((col,cl))
    return out

import os,re,numpy as np,json,collections,itertools
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
DIHEDRALES=[]
A=np.array([[1,0],[0,1]])
for k in range(4):
    M=np.rot90(A,k)
    for fl in (False,True):
        D=M[:,::-1] if fl else M
        # canonicalize
        D=np.array(D); best=None
        for kk in range(4):
            R=np.rot90(D,kk)
            idx=np.lexsort([R.flatten(), -R.sum(axis=0)])  # placeholder
            break
        DIHEDRALES.append(D)
# unique under transpose/reflection of identity mask approach too simple; do proper: 8 variants of bounding-box mask
def dihed_of(mask):
    ms=set()
    M=np.array(mask,dtype=int)
    cur=M
    for k in range(4):
        ms.add(tuple(cur.tobytes()))
        cur=np.fliplr(cur)
    for k in range(4):
        ms.add(tuple(np.fliplr(M).transpose(k//2*2+(k%2==0)).tobytes()))
    return ms
# proper: 8 dihedral = rotate/reflection combos
def diheds(M):
    out=set()
    cur=M
    for k in range(4):
        out.add(cur.astype(int).tobytes())
        out.add(cur[::-1, :].astype(int).tobytes())  # flipud? careful
        cur=np.rot90(cur)
    return {np.array(b).reshape(M.shape) for b in out}
# simpler explicit: rotations of M and flips
def d8(M):
    res=[]
    for k in range(4):
        res.append(np.rot90(M,k))
        res.append(np.fliplr(np.rot90(M,k)))
    uniq=[r for r in res if r.tolist() not in [x.tolist() for x in res[:res.index(r)]]]
    return uniq
print(len(DIHEDRALES))

import numpy as np,collections
def comps8(g,bg=None):
    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape
    seen=np.zeros_like(g,bool); out=[]
    for rr in range(H):
        for cc in range(W):
            if seen[rr,cc]: continue
            col=int(g[rr,cc]); q=[(rr,cc)]; seen[rr,cc]=True; cl=[]
            while q:
                a,b=q.pop(); cl.append((a,b))
                for dr in (-1,0,1):
                    for dc in (-1,0,1):
                        na,nb=a+dr,b+dc
                        if 0<=na<H and 0<=nb<W and not seen[na,nb] and g[na,nb]==col:
                            seen[na,nb]=True; q.append((na,nb))
            out.append((col,cl))

    res=[]; cur=M
